required_skills.name: Reading and interpreting architectural and MEP blueprints

responsibilities: Perform rough-in and finish plumbing installations for residential and commercial new construction projects, including multi-family housing and mixed-use developments
Install, repair, and maintain copper, PEX, CPVC, and cast iron piping systems for domestic water, waste, and vent applications
Install and service commercial boiler systems, including hydronic heating loops, expansion tanks, and circulating pumps for facilities up to 500,000 BTU
Perform backflow preventer installation, testing, and annual certification for both residential and commercial accounts
Install and commission tankless and traditional water heaters, including commercial-grade units and recirculation systems
Install medical gas piping systems in healthcare facilities in accordance with ASSE 6010 standards and NFPA 99 requirements
Design and install sustainable plumbing systems including rainwater harvesting, greywater recycling, and high-efficiency fixture packages for LEED-certified projects
Mentor and supervise apprentice and journeyman plumbers, providing on-the-job training and verifying work quality
Coordinate with general contractors, electricians, HVAC technicians, and building inspectors to ensure proper sequencing and code compliance
Maintain detailed daily work logs, material usage records, and service documentation using ServiceTitan field management software
Respond to emergency service calls on a rotating on-call basis (approximately one week per month)
